oe_parl_pa_nobles_frontier_estates = {
    type = country
    estate = nobles_estate
    importance = 2.0

    potential = {
        NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_parl_pa_mod_frontier_estates }
    }

    on_accept = {
        add_country_modifier = {
            modifier = oe_parl_pa_mod_frontier_estates
            years = 5
            mode = replace
        }
    }

    can_bribe = {
        can_bribe_default_trigger = yes
    }

    on_bribe = {
        on_bribe_default_effect = yes
    }

    ai_will_do = {
        add = 20
        subtract = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = scope:target value > 0.6 }
                }
                value = 15
            }
        }
    }

    chance = 10
}
